Implemented the authoring domain module in [authoring.py](file:///tmp/sdlc-runs/10cb8aa562d74f1c81612e908ab9c7e3/work/backend/src/pharma_agent/domain/corpus/authoring.py) with corresponding unit tests in [test_authoring.py](file:///tmp/sdlc-runs/10cb8aa562d74f1c81612e908ab9c7e3/work/backend/tests/domain/corpus/test_authoring.py):

- **`slugify(text, *, max_length=80)`**: Normalizes Vietnamese diacritics and special characters (`Đ`/`đ`), producing lowercase ASCII words joined by hyphens truncated to `max_length`.
- **`section_key(document_key, path)`**: Produces `<document_key>#<slugified path parts joined by "/">`, or `<document_key>#body` when the path is empty.
- **`split_markdown(markdown, *, fallback_heading)`**: Splits Markdown into sections with `heading`, `path` (the tuple of enclosing headings), `ordinal` (1-based), and `blocks`. Headings within fenced code blocks are ignored, text before any heading is titled `fallback_heading` with `path=()`, and sections with no content are dropped. Table row runs (lines starting with `|`) become table blocks with `table_key="t1"`, `"t2"`, ... numbered across the entire document, and intervening text becomes stripped prose blocks.
- **`section_choices(collection, documents)`**: Returns `(section key, label)` pairs in reading order where the label is the document title followed by the heading path, joined by ` › `.
- **`build_bundle(collection, documents, glossary, colloquial)`**: Assembles a deterministic `KnowledgeBundle` with documents sorted by `<collection_key>:<doc_key>`, one section record per section, the glossary as given, colloquial mappings with non-existent section keys pruned, and manifest carrying collection key, title, and counts.
